summary: More modules migrated from community.aws to amazon.aws in 10.0.0: iam_group, iam_managed_policy, iam_mfa_device_info, iam_password_policy, iam_role, iam_role_info, s3_bucket_info and sts_assume_role. Playbooks should use the amazon.aws FQCNs.
questions: What's the new FQCN for sts_assume_role?
Did iam_role move from community.aws to amazon.aws?

answer_card.title: IAM and STS modules moved to amazon.aws
answer_card.answer_md: Update FQCNs from `community.aws` to `amazon.aws` for: `iam_group`, `iam_managed_policy`, `iam_mfa_device_info`, `iam_password_policy`, `iam_role`, `iam_role_info`, `s3_bucket_info` and `sts_assume_role`.
